_comment: multiple-version line, MC 1.19.2 forge, declared `skip`. The row's marker is JEI's registration pass: JEI 11.x logs it while a level loads, and no non-interactive way to load a level exists before 1.20 (`--quickPlaySingleplayer` arrived in 1.20), so on either backend a 1.19.2 client reaches the title screen and nothing else. `skip` names exactly what is missing and the checks stay as written, so removing it is a follow-up that needs a 1.19.2-era way to load a level (see envs/README.md). The row is also not launched through the checkout's Gradle task, because the multiple-version Forge modules cannot carry the mod under test in a dev run (measured 2026-10-14 — see `Forge rows and the gradle backend` in envs/README.md); its fabric sibling is a menu-level gradle row instead, which claims no marker at all.
name: mv-1.19.2-forge
skip: JEI registration check needs world load; quickPlay needs 1.20+
